notes: Pinned upstream. Changing 'commit' or 'version' is a reviewed pull request: run `polestar_import.py diff` first and attach the report. Nothing here publishes anything.

excluded.addon/Polestar_QuestDB: Not in the repository (built locally) and includes QuestieDB facts, whose maintainers ask that it be treated as all rights reserved.
excluded.addon/Polestar_ItemDB/Items.lua: Classic Era client tables (build 1.15.9.70576), not WoW Forever.
excluded.addon/Polestar_ItemDB/Forever.lua: Derived from ForeverLevelingBiS (MIT) but shipped inside a GPL-3.0-only addon; not needed for the sample. Re-evaluate later from the MIT upstream.
excluded.guides/: Polestar's own guide text, GPL-3.0; LICENSE-EXCEPTION.md explicitly does not cover guide text. Walking legs use maps shared with Polestar's author only.
excluded.data/ui_map.jsonl: Not needed: map frames are read from our own client tables (UiMapAssignment, build 1.60.1.70862).
